description: This file contains unit tests for the Qbone session implementation in the QUIC protocol, including setup of client and server sessions, handshake procedures, packet processing, and control request handling.

classes.name: IndirectionProofSource
classes.description: A mock proof source for testing, providing server credentials.

classes.name: IndirectionProofVerifier
classes.description: A mock proof verifier for testing, verifying server credentials.

classes.name: DataSavingQbonePacketWriter
classes.description: A packet writer that saves written packets for inspection.

classes.name: DataSavingQboneControlHandler
classes.description: A control handler that records requests and errors for testing.

classes.name: FakeTaskRunner
classes.description: A mock task runner that schedules and runs tasks in order.

classes.name: QboneSessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture for testing Qbone session behaviors, including setup, handshake, packet processing, and control requests.

methods.name: TestPacketIn
methods.description: Creates a test packet with IPv6 header prepended.

methods.name: TestPacketOut
methods.description: Creates a test packet with IPv6 header prepended for outgoing packets.

methods.name: GetTestParams
methods.description: Returns supported QUIC versions with message frames for testing.

methods.name: CreateClientAndServerSessions
methods.description: Sets up mock client and server QUIC sessions with optional handshake success and ALPN configuration.

methods.name: StartHandshake
methods.description: Initiates handshake process between client and server sessions.

methods.name: ExpectICMPTooBigResponse
methods.description: Verifies that an ICMP 'Packet Too Big' response is sent with specified MTU.

methods.name: TestStreamConnection
methods.description: Tests data stream sending, receiving, and handling of large payloads.

methods.name: TestDisconnectAfterFailedHandshake
methods.description: Checks that sessions are not connected after handshake failure.
